title: World Brief
overview: Demonstration edition: twelve sample developments across six regions and five topics.

stories.headline: Baltic states agree shared monitoring of undersea cables
stories.summary: Three Baltic governments signed an agreement to share monitoring data on undersea cables. The arrangement takes effect in January.

claims.text: Three Baltic governments signed an agreement to share monitoring data on undersea cables.

evidence.quote: Demo passage: Three Baltic governments signed an agreement to share monitoring data on undersea cables.
Demo passage: Three Baltic governments signed an agreement to share monitoring data on undersea cables.

claims.text: The arrangement takes effect in January.

evidence.quote: Demo passage: The arrangement takes effect in January.

stories.whyItMatters: Undersea cables carry most of the region's data and power links, so shared monitoring shortens the time to spot damage.
stories.context: Several cables in the area were damaged over the past two years.

articles.title: Baltic states agree shared monitoring of undersea cables
